scope.removed: NativeFeatureState reset journals, queues, automatic source/style clears and frame/style reset scheduling; same-ID source remount clearing guarantee and reset-only tests.

scope.routing: RNMapbox state remains map-scoped and accepts style/vector source IDs without requiring a facade GeoJSON registration. Its GeoJSON registry uses current getters for clusters. MapLibre checks the current map and current registered source kind, validates vector sourceLayer and dispatches to the correct current ref.
scope.lifetime: Operations dispatch directly before their first wrapper await. No first-party transaction, retry, ordering queue, shadow state or cancellation of already-sent SDK work is promised. Later calls resolve current refs; stale cleanup cannot release replacement registrations. Renderer/wrapper owns state lifetime across source/style changes.
scope.fixtures: Query and lifetime scenarios explicitly remove/reapply destination identifiers after source/style generation readiness. Both SDK-retained and naturally-cleared state are tested. Existing query, cluster, error, cancellation and attachment observations remain; no automatic mock clearing masks missing application cleanup.
